stop-propagation.name: Stop Propagation
stop-propagation.tip: Generally used in element events, when the user clicks on an element, it will first trigger the click event on the element, and then trigger the click event of the parent element, passing up the layer, and when this operation is performed, it will stop passing.

pause.name: Pause and Save to Variable
pause.tip: Executing this action pauses the currently executing event and saves the event to an object variable.

continue.name: Continue and Reset Variable
continue.tip: Continue the paused event and set the variable to a "none" value.

enable.name: Enable Global Event
enable.tip: Automatic triggering of the event will return to normal.

disable.name: Disable Global Event
disable.tip: Will no longer automatically trigger the event (Key Down, Mouse Down, etc.).

highest-priority.name: Set to Highest Priority
highest-priority.tip: Once the event is set to the highest priority, it can be triggered even when the game is paused.

goto-choice-branch.name: Go to Choice Branch
goto-choice-branch.tip: You can enter the specified choice branch after calling the "Show Choices" command.

setEvent-choiceIndex.label: Choice Index
setEvent-choiceIndex.tip: Jump to the Nth (0, 1, 2, ...) choice branch
